en.title: Learning Agent now is like getting into Douyin in 2018. If you had started learning self-media in 2020, you would surely have built up solid results by now; the same goes for starting to learn AI Agent development now. Back then, no one realized that self-media meant a disruption to content distribution: gaining hundreds or thousands of followers was no longer a privilege reserved for celebrities, and promoting a product no longer necessarily meant working with traditional media.
